payment.title: {{token}} Payment
payment.subtitleSelect: Choose a currency and network to continue
payment.countdownSubtitle: Complete the transfer before time runs out. Do not pay after expiry — place a new order instead.
payment.selectInstr1: Choose your preferred token and network to pay
payment.instruction1: You must transfer over the {{network}} network — never send {{warningToken}}.
payment.instruction1Native: You must send {{token}} over the {{network}} network — never use another chain.
payment.instruction2: The order is confirmed automatically once the funds arrive
payment.instruction3: You pay the network fee: exactly {{amount}} must arrive — anything less cannot be confirmed automatically
payment.instruction4: Any questions? Reach out to the merchant's support team.
payment.timeoutMessage:
Sorry, the payment window has closed.
Please restart the payment or contact support.
payment.confirmationNote: Please hold on, we'll update the status automatically.
payment.paymentSuccessNote: Your payment is confirmed and the transaction is complete.
payment.canceledMessage:
This order has been canceled and can no longer be paid.
Please place a new order to continue.
payment.failedMessage:
This transaction failed to confirm.
Please contact the merchant's support team.
payment.orderNotPayable: The current order status does not allow payment
payment.loadOrderFailed: Failed to load the order — please place a new one from the merchant
payment.loadPaymentNetworkFailed: Payment network failed to load — make sure wallet addresses are configured.
payment.createTransactionFailed: Could not create the transaction. Please try again.
payment.subtitleExchange: Send an internal transfer to the account UID below inside the {{networkName}} app
payment.instructionExchange: Use internal transfer inside the exchange app to this UID (no fee); do not use on-chain withdrawal
payment.instructionExchangeBinance: Binance App → Wallet → Withdraw → “Binance user / internal transfer”, or Binance Pay, recipient = this Binance ID (Pay ID); do not choose on-chain withdrawal
payment.instructionExchangeOkx: OKX App → Assets → Withdraw → “Internal transfer”, recipient = this UID; do not choose on-chain withdrawal
payment.amountCaption: You pay the network fee — this is the amount that must arrive
payment.instructionFee: You pay the network fee: the amount shown is the amount to receive. Make sure exactly {{amount}} arrives; if your wallet deducts the fee from the amount sent, add the fee on top
